The Vendetta Gazette

Vol. XII • June 22, 2026 • “All the Blood That’s Fit to Print” • Two Cents (If You’re Still Alive to Pay)

★ TERRITORY GAINS THIS WEEK ★ Sir Caprice        +70 turfs
Donald Trump      +17 turfs
Free Willy         +16 turfs
Wu-Tang           +1 turf

The Annihilator Unchained — Sir Caprice Obliterates Seventeen Headquarters in a Single Week

Seventeen Bosses Dethroned, Eight Players Erased from the Map Entirely; Vendetta City Has Never Seen Such Methodical Slaughter By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

Last week, dear reader, this correspondent had occasion to describe Sir Caprice as a devastating engine of territorial conquest after the man eliminated three bosses and seized thirty-six turfs in a single bloody fortnight. This week, your humble scribe is forced to concede that such prose was, in hindsight, a grotesque understatement — the rhetorical equivalent of calling the Great Flood a spot of inconvenient drizzle.

Sir Caprice — henceforth to be known in these pages as The Annihilator, for no lesser sobriquet shall suffice — has this week stormed, seized, and shattered seventeen enemy headquarters in seven days. Seventeen. This correspondent paused upon tallying that figure, removed his spectacles, cleaned them carefully, replaced them, and tallied again. The number did not change. Seventeen headquarters reduced to smouldering ruin. Arikusa, 3424sdaczx, ad, Flextonick, ravenua, XXV, Pendeho, ssimoss, Amirmh0235 — the roll call of the vanquished reads like a casualty dispatch from the Western Front.

The numbers beggar further description. The Annihilator now commands a garrison of six thousand, seven hundred and forty-nine battle-hardened souls, having added two hundred and eighteen fresh enforcers, bouncers and henchmen to his already-fearsome ranks this week alone. He expanded his territorial holdings by seventy turfs — nearly double last week's already-staggering haul — while simultaneously conducting twenty-one raids that stripped his enemies' coffers bare. This is not mere crime; this is empire.

Sources close to what remains of the opposition whisper that several bosses, upon learning that The Annihilator's columns were approaching, simply packed their valuables and vacated without firing a single shot. Eight players have vanished from the map entirely this week — Prinsipe1, Arikusa, Flextonick, VCD, aba, 3424sdaczx, abs, and bee all gone, their turfs swallowed whole, their names fading from the leaderboard like chalk in the rain. Ravenua, who last week absorbed eight turf losses and clung grimly to existence, has now seen her garrison reduced to precisely zero and her streets fall silent. The Iron Lady of the Eastern Corridors, it appears, has finally been extinguished.

Wcrypto — The Most Plundered Man in Vendetta City

Seventeen Raids, Eighteen Turf Seizures; Donald Trump Extracts the Maximum at Every Opportunity By Our Crime Desk

If Sir Caprice has dominated the headlines through sheer volume of destruction, spare a moment's grim sympathy for Wcrypto, who has endured a week of such sustained, remorseless pillaging that it strains the very vocabulary of misfortune. Wcrypto suffered the indignity of having his territories seized eighteen times and his vaults raided seventeen times, surrendering seventeen turfs in total and watching his garrison crumble from two hundred and seventy-six down to a skeletal two hundred and fifty-four.

The most spectacular single extraction was performed not by The Annihilator but by Donald Trump — the Brass-Knuckled Baron of the Boulevard — who descended upon Wcrypto's most flush storehouse and departed with a clean five hundred dollars in cash, forty-seven assorted arms, and a tidy parcel of hard-won experience points.
